PALINTROPOS · SHALLOW WATER

Flow over a mountain

Williamson test case 5 · T63
Four saved states, 0–15 days. No time interpolation.


Colours are sampled on a 2° mesh with one fixed scale per field across all four states. The globe is a reference sphere: height is encoded by colour, without radial exaggeration.

Free surface = fluid thickness + projected bottom terrain. W5 has one fluid layer, so it has no pressure, height, or σ selector. Streamlines show the frozen horizontal wind, with arrowheads pointing downstream; they are not trajectories.
